steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; update_option( 'permalink_structure', '/%postname%/' ); if ( class_exists( '\\BuddyX\\Buddyx\\Starter_Content\\Component' ) ) { ( new \BuddyX\Buddyx\Starter_Content\Component() )->create_demo_content(); update_option( 'buddyx_demo_setup_state', 'done' ); } if ( function_exists( 'bp_core_add_page_mappings' ) && function_exists( 'bp_core_get_directory_page_ids' ) ) { if ( ! array_filter( (array) bp_core_get_directory_page_ids( 'all' ) ) ) { bp_core_add_page_mappings( (array) bp_get_option( 'bp-active-components' ), 'keep' ); } } flush_rewrite_rules( false );
